question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Sher-E-Bangla, born in 1873 in Barishal, was a prominent leader in Bangladesh. He excelled academically, earning his M.A. and B.L. degrees before entering public service. After resigning as Deputy Magistrate in 1912, he joined the Bengal Council and became influential in the Indian Congress and Muslim League. He served as Chief Minister and established numerous educational institutions. Notably, he proposed the Pakistan Resolution in 1940. Sher-E- Bangla passed away at 89, leaving a lasting legacy in Bangladesh.
